item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas lha rgod thog pa'i zlog pa'i las rims
item.coloph: zhes zlog pa'i bskyed rim cung tsam sbyar ba 'dis kyang / khro tshogs rnams bdag lus kyi lhar grub pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig bstan pa rin po che dar zhing yun gnas par gyur cigaces rang bzo lhan thabs lta bur bdag gsang sngags gling pas chu pho 'brug lor steng chen gser khang du sbyar ba'o// gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ gsang sngags rgya che rol pa'i bcud blangs shing / mi mthun rtsod pa bzlog pa'i phyir du/ 7bla chen dran pa nam mkhas ma 'ongs don du gter du sbas/ phyis dus mu la drung mu yis/ bka' gter ma bu kha sprad nas/ shing phag lo yi yar ngos dus/ rig 'dzin gsang sngags gling pa yi (yis/)phyi nang gsang ba'i lha rnams kun/ gcig tu dril nas bdag gis sbyar/ bkra shis bon bstan dar rgyas shog/
